Eva usually has chicken for breakfast. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bird-watching spot by bike. There are always many people at the camping site. For example, this cleaner contains strong chemicals.
Eva hopes to visit Toronto one day. The bird-watching spot is one of the best places in the city. Life is full of small surprises. The kids made a big splash when they jumped in.
Eva thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Eva wrote about the day in the diary. Eva is reading a book about history. Best of all, her son works as a stockbroker in London.
Eva and Sam had great fun there. Sam is interested in reading. Eva's favorite animal is the panda.
